# A Player Mode

> A Player Mode is a five-role executive team for your day (Executive Coach, Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Accountability Partner, Cognitive Behavioral Mindset Coach) that reduces cognitive load. It comes two ways: the A Player Mode app, which runs your day for you, or the Billionaire High Performance Coach OS, a one-time digital product that installs the same five roles into the AI you already use. Made by Spry Labs.

## The two ways
- The A Player Mode app: a subscription app (web and Android today; iPhone awaiting store approval). It builds your plan, has the agenda ready each morning, tracks dropped promises (Radar) and, on higher plans, acts for you. Web app: https://app.aplayermode.com
- Billionaire High Performance Coach OS: a one-time download (50-page operating manual, executable prompt pack, platform guide, the Arbitration Engine) that you install into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek or another LLM, then run yourself each morning. $49 once on Gumroad: https://sprylabs.gumroad.com/l/billionaire-high-performance-coach

## App plans (USD)
- Executive Roundtable: $24.99/month or $249.99/year. All 5 roles; it plans and coaches you, you do the last step.
- Executive Suite: $39.99/month or $399.99/year. Everything in Executive Roundtable, plus relationships, bills, appointments and life admin prepared for one-tap approval.
- Autopilot: $79.99/month or $799.99/year. Everything in Executive Suite, plus standing rules it carries out on its own and multiple connected accounts.
- Founding 100: the first 100 members get Executive Roundtable at $9.99/month for as long as they stay subscribed. After that, Executive Roundtable is $9.99/month for the first 3 months, then $24.99/month.
- There is no free trial. Cancel any time from Settings, Manage subscription.

## Who it is for
Founders, executives, operators, parents, athletes, students, creatives and anyone carrying too many projects, roles and rules in their head.
